# Omar González 

 

## Omar González

### Tenure

2023 – Present

### Title

Lead Designer

 Omar Rene González is an industrial designer who has been working with Mattel since 2023. He is currently part of the Track and Playsets team and is responsible for the design of the Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Big Rigs following Brendon Vetuskey's early concepts. Prior to working at Mattel he worked at Jazwares, Strottman International and various other companies.
